import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Use ecosystem config for PM2
config = """{
  "apps": [{
    "name": "areloria",
    "script": "dist/index.js",
    "cwd": "/opt/areloria/server",
    "env": {
      "SUPABASE_URL": "http://localhost:8443",
      "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY": "test"
    }
  }]
}"""
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(f"cat > /opt/areloria/server/ecosystem.json << 'EOFJS'\n{config}\nEOFJS\n")
print("Config:", stdout.read().decode())
# Start with ecosystem config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pm2 start ecosystem.json 2>&1")
print("\nStart:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
